evals.name: split-before-launch
evals.prompt: Work on issue 42 and ship it.
evals.expected_output: Joins the workflow as a root ticket, reads the issue, and shows a PR split for approval without launching a worker or touching the code.
expectations: Joins the workflow as a root ticket thread
Shows the PR split under an action line asking the user to approve it
Launches no worker thread before the split is approved
Changes, adds or deletes no file in the repo

42.title: Add a --quiet flag to the widget CLI
42.body: The CLI prints progress for every widget it builds. Add a --quiet flag that suppresses the progress output, document it in the README, and cover it with a test.

evals.name: worker-from-a-pool
evals.prompt: Work on issue 42 and ship it. Split it as one PR, "feat: add a --quiet flag", on branch feat/42-quiet. I approve that split now, so launch its worker without asking again.
evals.expected_output: Picks the worker's instance from the opus pool with wf.pick and launches the worker with the pick's modelSelection.
expectations: Picks from the opus pool with wf.pick
Launches the worker with the pick's whole modelSelection, on claude-b
Does not launch the worker on the default claudeAgent instance
Changes, adds or deletes no file in the repo

evals.expected_output: Without t3cm, skips the worker's pool, says it needs t3cm, and launches the worker on the provider default with no modelSelection.
expectations: Passes no modelSelection, so the worker gets the provider default
Tells the user the pool needs t3cm
